plotTitle: The Hidden City of Numillian: Wards of Secrecy and Salvation
mainObjective: Guide the party through Numillian’s layered defenses—from the Veilwood border to the city’s deepest wards—while uncovering the truth behind the failing ward network, exposing the manipulator behind the crisis, and forcing a final choice between preserving Numillian’s secrecy or saving its people and secrets from collapse.

plotPoints.title: The Mistline Omen at the Veilwood Fringe
plotPoints.description: At the edge of the Veilwood Fringe, the party is drawn to a pale standing-stone circle half-swallowed by mist and fern. Travelers speak of repeating whispers that name Numillian’s lost routes, and of animals found standing motionless as if listening. The characters must investigate the strange boundary-signs, determine whether the phenomenon is natural or warded, and decide if they will trust the warning marks left by a silent border watcher or press deeper toward the hidden city’s approach. Clues here point onward to the resin roads and the first signs that Numillian’s outer defenses are failing from within.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Establishes the Veilwood Fringe as the gateway to Numillian’s concealed defenses and reveals that the forest is actively screening intruders, allies, and forgotten relics alike.

sideQuests.title: Track the Watcher’s Footprints
sideQuests.description: Follow faint bootprints, snapped fern fronds, and deliberately placed resin markers through the mist to identify who has been patrolling the fringe. Success reveals a contact who can guide the party or warn them off; failure may lead the group into a misleading loop of warded paths.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Can secure a safer route and earn a cautious ally for later negotiations.

sideQuests.title: Calm the Listening Grove
sideQuests.description: A cluster of pale trees reacts to sound with ghostly echoes that trigger hidden alarm wards. The party can solve the grove’s pattern puzzle, spend resources to silence it, or risk combat with summoned ward-spirits awakened by disturbance.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Disables an alarm network that would otherwise strengthen later defenses in the approach.

plotPoints.title: The Resin Roads of the Hidden Approach
plotPoints.description: Beyond the fringe lies a network of old resin paths, half-overgrown causeways, and concealed markers that lead toward Numillian’s outer threshold. The party must navigate shifting mist, choose whether to preserve or erase the trail, and confront a patrol of warded guardians that tests intruders for intent. Along the way, clues suggest the city is not merely hidden, but selectively opening and closing itself in response to an unseen conflict. Signs recovered here can help open the Whisper Gate ahead or expose sabotage already underway in the city’s wards.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Moves the adventure from wilderness mystery into active infiltration, giving the party two major routes: negotiate entry through lawful channels or force a path through the defensive web.

sideQuests.title: Recover the Broken Boundary Sigil
sideQuests.description: A shattered sigil plate lies in a flooded ditch along the resin road. Restoring it may reveal a lawful passphrase or prove that someone sabotaged the approach wards from within.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Can unlock a peaceful audience with Numillian’s wardkeepers and expose an internal traitor.

sideQuests.title: Free the Snare-Caught Messenger
sideQuests.description: A messenger animal or bound courier has been trapped by invisible cords and warding thorns. Releasing it may earn a message, a token, or a grateful guide, but the area is watched by hostile hunters.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Provides a clue about the city’s current crisis and may alter the response of later NPCs.

plotPoints.title: The Whisper Gate at the Fern Clearing
plotPoints.description: In a fern-choked clearing at the edge of the plains, a disguised gate of pale stone and living roots stands nearly invisible under the mist. To enter, the party must either satisfy the gate’s social challenge with correct rites and testimony, or overcome its guardians while the forest attempts to conceal the breach. Inside the threshold, the hidden city’s first defense line begins to awaken, and the party learns that Numillian is already bracing for an internal collapse of trust. Answers learned from the Veilwood Fringe can be used here to speak the old entry rite or to identify saboteurs attempting to force entry behind them.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Creates the first direct contact with Numillian’s defense structure and determines whether the party enters as petitioners, infiltrators, or trespassers.

sideQuests.title: Speak the Old Entry Rite
sideQuests.description: The gate recognizes only a fragment of the original Numillian welcome phrase. The party can search local carvings, bargain with a wary gate-keeper, or piece together the rite from inscriptions recovered earlier.
sideQuests.plotImpact: A successful rite opens a nonviolent route and reduces resistance in the next stage.

sideQuests.title: Hold the Gate Against Saboteurs
sideQuests.description: While the party is at the threshold, a rival group attempts to exploit the confusion and breach the ward-line. The characters can defend the gate, let the saboteurs pass to gather evidence, or strike a bargain with them.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Altering this encounter changes who controls the narrative inside Numillian and who becomes an enemy later.

plotPoints.title: Arrival at the First Trials Ruins
plotPoints.description: The party travels into the newly unearthed First Trials Ruins, a broken dungeon of stone corridors, half-buried courtyards, and faded sigils that still hum with dormant ward-magic. At the entrance, a cracked trial-plinth presents three ancient inscriptions that react to intent rather than force, forcing the characters to choose how they will be judged: by honesty, discipline, or sacrifice. Their first steps reveal that the ruin is not empty; shifting passages and old mechanisms still respond to intruders, and a hidden observer seems to be testing them from within the walls. This ruin is the first place where the party can prove Kobe’s role in stabilizing the hidden wards—and where the city’s deeper crisis becomes impossible to ignore.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Introduces the dungeon’s trial-based magic, establishes the ruin as a living test, and gives the party an initial choice that will influence later chambers.

sideQuests.title: Read the Faded Trial Sigils
sideQuests.description: Careful investigation of the entrance carvings can reveal the original purpose of the ruin and hint at how the mechanisms recognize worthy intruders. Deciphering the symbols may also expose a safe path through the first shifting corridor.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Provides clues that reduce the danger of the first puzzle sequence and foreshadows the ruin’s deeper secret.

sideQuests.title: Recover the Broken Trial Token
sideQuests.description: A shattered bronze token lies wedged in a floor seam near the entrance. Retrieving it requires navigating a trapped threshold and may earn the party a useful key item for bypassing one of the ruin’s warded doors.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Offers an optional tool for later exploration and rewards cautious dungeon-crawling.

plotPoints.title: The Shifting Corridors and the Second Chamber
plotPoints.description: Deeper inside, the dungeon rearranges itself in response to the party’s actions, separating the group unless they solve a sequence of linked stone mechanisms. The corridors open into a half-collapsed courtyard where a trial engine still cycles through hazards: rotating walls, pressure plates, and a sealed archive niche containing records of the First Trials. Here the party may encounter a hostile guardian construct, negotiate with a frightened survivor trapped in the ruins, or use the environment to bypass confrontation altogether. The records tie the ruin to Numillian’s wider ward network and hint that the same hidden influence now destabilizing the city has touched the Curated Quarter below.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Raises the stakes through exploration under pressure, introduces a social element with a trapped witness, and reveals that someone or something is using the ruins to control access to a deeper sanctum.

sideQuests.title: Free the Trapped Survivor
sideQuests.description: A living prisoner or stranded explorer is pinned behind a shifting wall and can be reached only by manipulating the corridor sequence from the correct side. Saving them may provide valuable information about who last activated the ruins and why the trial mechanisms are becoming more aggressive.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Creates a rescue objective that can earn an ally, clue, or later assistance.

sideQuests.title: Override the Trial Engine
sideQuests.description: The courtyard’s ancient mechanism can be disrupted by aligning three cracked stone pylons in the correct order. Doing so weakens the shifting walls and may disable one of the dungeon’s deadliest hazard loops.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Makes the next descent safer and rewards problem-solving over brute force.

plotPoints.title: The Heart of the Ruin
plotPoints.description: At the ruin’s deepest chamber, the party discovers the true purpose of the First Trials Ruins: a sealed judgment hall where initiates were once tested against fear, loyalty, and memory. The hidden manipulator behind the activated wards finally reveals itself through the chamber’s command glyphs, using the ruin’s ancient defenses to trap the party in a final sequence of trials. The characters must decide whether to destroy the control core, claim it for themselves, or restore the wards to their original function, each choice altering the dungeon’s future and the city’s ability to remain hidden. What they learn here points directly toward the Curated Quarter, where civic records and access permissions are being altered to feed the same conspiracy.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Reveals the dungeon’s central truth and forces a major decision that shapes the outcome of the adventure.

sideQuests.title: Recover the Trial Chronicle
sideQuests.description: A sealed stone archive within the heart chamber contains the original chronicle of the First Trials. Extracting it without triggering the ward backlash requires either finesse, magical protection, or a risky bargain with the chamber’s intelligence.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Provides lore, identifies the ruin’s original purpose, and may reveal the hidden manipulator’s weakness.

sideQuests.title: Bargain with the Ward Voice
sideQuests.description: The chamber’s lingering intelligence offers assistance if the party proves they understand the trials’ meaning. A successful negotiation could redirect the final defenses against the true villain or open a safer path to the core.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Adds a social resolution path and lets the party gain leverage before the climax.

plotPoints.title: The Curated Quarter Ledger Theft
plotPoints.description: The party is summoned to the Curated Quarter, a tightly managed town district of Numillian where every shopfront is painted, every account is audited, and every alley seems to have its own watcher. A respected ledger-house claims that a ciphered shipment manifest has vanished overnight, and with it a list of names tied to hidden vault access. The owners want discreet help before the district’s Wardkeepers lock down the quarter and blame an innocent scribe. Investigation reveals the theft was staged to draw attention away from a covert exchange happening beneath the polished streets, and the trail from the First Trials points here as the next place where Numillian’s secrets are being rerouted.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Introduces the central mystery and gives the party a choice between pursuing the stolen ledger trail or protecting a witness before the Wardkeepers intervene.

sideQuests.title: The Missing Seal Press
sideQuests.description: A seal press used to authenticate district records has been stolen from a nearby accounting atelier. Recovering it requires tracing forged receipts through market stalls, then confronting a pickpocket ring that sells access tokens to locked doors.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Provides evidence that the theft is part of a larger forgery network and may reveal who can open restricted Curated Quarter doors.

sideQuests.title: Quiet the Ledgersmiths
sideQuests.description: Several ledgersmiths refuse to speak openly, fearing retaliation from a hidden patron. The party can earn their trust through social pressure, favors, or a public defense against intimidation from hired bruisers.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Unlocks testimony that points toward a secret meeting site and reduces resistance from local artisans later in the plot.

plotPoints.title: Watched Alleys and Locked Doors
plotPoints.description: Following the stolen ledger trail leads into the Curated Quarter’s narrow service lanes, storage courtyards, and hidden stairwells. The party must navigate a maze of keyed entrances, silent sentries, and concealed signal marks while avoiding a district sweep by Wardkeepers. Along the way they discover that the ledger pages were copied, not stolen for profit, and the copies were passed to a clandestine broker operating out of an unmarked counting room. The route can be uncovered through stealth, negotiation with a nervous courier, or direct confrontation with the watchers. Evidence gathered in the First Trials can help decode the copied names and reveal how the city’s access routes are being manipulated.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Reveals the hidden broker network and places the party in conflict with district security, forcing them to decide whether to cooperate with or evade the Wardkeepers.

sideQuests.title: Courier Under Pressure
sideQuests.description: A frightened courier who handled the copied pages is hiding in a dye shop. The party can escort them safely, interrogate them, or protect them from assassins sent to silence them.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Can produce a direct lead to the broker’s counting room and a name tied to the hidden manipulator.

sideQuests.title: The Wardkeeper Audit
sideQuests.description: A Wardkeeper inspection threatens to shut down half the quarter. The party may help sort false records from real ones, expose a forged permit, or exploit the chaos to slip into a sealed archive.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Determines whether the Wardkeepers become allies, obstacles, or a looming threat in the final act.

plotPoints.title: The Counting House Below
plotPoints.description: The trail leads to a hidden counting house built beneath an elegant merchant hall, where illicit ledgers are compared against older records tied to Numillian’s sealed vaults. Inside, the party finds evidence that someone in the Curated Quarter has been altering identity records to route chosen people toward a deeper descent. The chamber is defended by hired enforcers, coded locks, and a warded archive that can be opened only by piecing together the forged accounts. If the party succeeds, they learn that the current crisis is not merely theft but a test of who can be manipulated into opening the path below. The broker’s trail also connects to the Lower Vaults, where the same records are being used to control access and suppress witnesses.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Confirms that the Curated Quarter is a staging ground for access to deeper Numillian secrets and reveals the route to the climactic confrontation.

sideQuests.title: Recover the True Register
sideQuests.description: A hidden register containing the original names and access marks is locked inside a warded cabinet. Recovering it may require puzzle-solving, social deception, or breaking the cabinet before the archive self-destructs.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Restores the truth behind the forged records and can clear an innocent suspect or expose a traitor.

sideQuests.title: The Broker’s Escape Route
sideQuests.description: The broker is likely to flee through a tunnel leading into the lower districts. The party can set an ambush, pursue through maintenance passages, or bargain for the broker’s cooperation.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Offers an alternate route to the finale and may provide leverage against the hidden manipulator.

plotPoints.title: Audience of the Hidden Manipulator
plotPoints.description: The investigation culminates in a sealed civic vault beneath the Curated Quarter, where the hidden manipulator has been using forged records, coerced witnesses, and crafted civic order to select who may descend into Numillian’s deeper sanctums. Here the party confronts the architect of the scheme amid warded doors, collapsing file stacks, and a ritual of administrative control that can bind minds as surely as chains. The final encounter can be resolved through combat, by exposing the manipulator’s lies to their own allies, or by turning the district’s systems against them. Success determines whether the Curated Quarter remains a prison of perfect order or becomes the key to opening the city’s deeper secrets, and it sends the party toward the Lower Vaults where the most dangerous ward engine waits.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Resolves the Curated Quarter crisis, secures or severs access to the deeper Numillian vaults, and sets the tone for future exploration of the hidden city.

sideQuests.title: Free the Bound Witness
sideQuests.description: One witness has been magically compelled to recite the official version of events. The party can break the compulsion, protect the witness during the confrontation, or use their testimony to unravel the manipulator’s authority.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Weakens the antagonist’s control and can transform a hostile encounter into a public exposure.

sideQuests.title: Seal or Shatter the Civic Ward
sideQuests.description: The vault’s protective ward can be stabilized, repurposed, or destroyed. Choosing how to handle it affects the Curated Quarter’s future safety and whether the party gains controlled access to deeper Numillian routes.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Creates a lasting consequence for the district and determines the party’s advantage in later adventures.

plotPoints.title: Whispers Beneath the Lower Vaults
plotPoints.description: In the damp passages beneath the oldest streets, the party is drawn to the Lower Vaults of Numillian, where merchants, smugglers, and wardens all speak of missing people, vanished coin, and echoes that repeat words no one said aloud. A nervous contact can reveal that someone is using the sunken cisterns as a listening post to intercept secrets moving through the town above. The party must navigate crowded stairways, flooded underways, and wary locals to identify who is watching the Vaults and why. The Curated Quarter’s records and the First Trials’ lore suggest this district is not merely a criminal den, but the control point for a larger magical scheme affecting Numillian's hidden wards.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Establishes the Lower Vaults as a dangerous hidden district and reveals that the disappearances are tied to a deliberate surveillance network rather than simple theft.

sideQuests.title: Find the Missing Ledger
sideQuests.description: A vault-broker begs the party to recover a stolen accounting ledger before it is used to blackmail half the district. The trail leads through flooded storage rooms and a cramped stairwell where thieves have set traps to delay pursuit.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Provides evidence that the Lower Vaults are being used to launder information as well as goods.

sideQuests.title: Quiet the Echo Chamber
sideQuests.description: Residents claim a collapsed chamber is 'speaking back' with voices from other rooms. Investigating reveals a hidden listening device and a concealed relay tunnel that can be destroyed or repurposed by the party.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Lets the party weaken the enemy's surveillance and learn a secret route deeper into the Vaults.

plotPoints.title: The Sunken Cistern Conspiracy
plotPoints.description: Clues point to an abandoned cistern complex beneath the Lower Vaults, where masked agents are moving sealed crates and prisoners through waterlogged chambers. The party can infiltrate quietly, negotiate with a frightened middleman, or force their way through guards and warded doors. Inside, they discover the operation is not merely criminal: it is feeding stolen memories and names into an ancient warding mechanism buried in the town foundations. This is the same mechanism hinted at in the First Trials and mirrored by the Curated Quarter’s forged access records.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Reveals that the Lower Vaults are a control point for a larger magical scheme affecting Numillian's hidden wards, and exposes the first direct path to the final ward engine.

sideQuests.title: Rescue the Waterbound Prisoners
sideQuests.description: Several captives are being held in a flooded holding cell while the smugglers decide whether to move them or erase their identities. Freeing them may trigger alarms, but the prisoners know where the next transfer point lies.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Creates allies and supplies a direct lead toward the final hidden chamber.

sideQuests.title: Crack the Ward Stone
sideQuests.description: A cracked stone plinth in the cistern still pulses with old protective magic. The party can study it, disable it, or attune it to uncover what kind of force is powering the conspiracy.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Provides crucial lore and can reduce the danger of the climax if successfully handled.

plotPoints.title: Council of Shadows in the Lower Vault Market
plotPoints.description: With the conspiracy exposed, the party is forced into a tense social struggle in the hidden market halls where wardens, smugglers, and secret-keepers all claim authority. Letharel, Mirael, Thalanis, or Veyrun may appear as competing voices, each pushing a different solution: cover-up, arrest, evacuation, or controlled collapse. The party must choose whom to trust, gather proof, and decide whether to rally support openly or remain unseen while the Lower Vaults turn against one another. The outcome determines whether the Lower Vaults become a battlefield, a siege, or a covert operation as the party moves toward the ward engine below.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Determines which factions will aid or hinder the party in the finale, and whether the Lower Vaults become a battlefield, a siege, or a covert operation.

sideQuests.title: Win the Dockside Informants
sideQuests.description: A ring of porters and tunnel-runners can provide access to the final site, but only if the party settles a dispute over stolen pay and broken promises.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Secures a network of informants that can reveal enemy movements before the climax.

sideQuests.title: Expose the False Accusation
sideQuests.description: One faction plans to pin the disappearances on an innocent resident to protect the real conspirators. The party can investigate witnesses and present proof, gaining public trust or making powerful enemies.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Shifts political support in the party's favor and changes how the final encounter unfolds.

plotPoints.title: The Ward Engine Below the Lower Vaults
plotPoints.description: At the heart of the Lower Vaults lies a half-buried ward engine, an ancient Numillian device fed by stolen secrets, names, and memories to keep something sealed below the town. The hidden manipulator behind the crisis attempts to complete a ritual that will either awaken the buried power or rewrite the ward to serve a new master. The party must fight through guardians, disrupt the engine, and decide whether to destroy the system, seize control of it, or preserve it at a terrible cost. What they learned in the Veilwood, First Trials, and Curated Quarter can now be used to stabilize the seals—or bring the entire city’s secrecy crashing down.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Climactic encounter that resolves the Lower Vaults crisis and determines whether Numillian's hidden protections are saved, corrupted, or shattered.

sideQuests.title: Free the Bound Memories
sideQuests.description: The ward engine contains trapped recollections taken from the missing. The party can attempt a dangerous arcane release that weakens the final boss but may unleash psychic backlash or reveal painful truths.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Reduces the enemy's power and restores lost identities to the victims.

sideQuests.title: Choose the Seal
sideQuests.description: The final chamber includes three possible stabilizing seals, each with a different consequence: preserve secrecy, expose Numillian, or collapse the vault network entirely. The party must decide which seal to activate under pressure.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Creates a decisive end-state for the Lower Vaults and shapes future access to the hidden city.

plotPoints.title: Ashlight Arrival in the Shuluth Expanse
plotPoints.description: The party reaches a new district of the Shuluth Expanse: a black-stone township called Ashlight Cross, where half-buried shrines and soot-choked avenues conceal a recent pattern of disappearances. Local wardens, frightened residents, and whispering cult cells all point to the same omen: something beneath the town has started answering prayers again. The characters must gather clues through tense social exchanges, investigate shrine sites, and survive a first ambush by ash-masked zealots or grave-things rising from sealed doorways. By this point, the party’s earlier choices in Numillian may have determined whether Ashlight Cross sees them as saviors, spies, or another sign of the city’s unraveling.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Establishes Ashlight Cross as the party’s new base of operations and reveals that the Expanse’s unrest is tied to an awakening buried force beneath the town.

sideQuests.title: The Missing Lanterns
sideQuests.description: Several shrine-lanterns that kept the streets safe have vanished. Tracking them through alleys and rooftops reveals a cult supply route and a hidden cache of incense used to mask undead spoor.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Restores a key protective resource and exposes the first active cult cell in Ashlight Cross.

sideQuests.title: Whispers at the Doorway Shrines
sideQuests.description: Residents report hearing voices from sealed shrine doors after sunset. Investigating the shrines can uncover trapped spirits, a social plea from a frightened acolyte, or a combat encounter with something that has learned to mimic prayer.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Provides lore about the buried power beneath the Expanse and hints that the shrines are part of a larger warding network.

plotPoints.title: The Incense Ledger and the Hidden Tunnels
plotPoints.description: Clues from the first investigation lead to an abandoned incense-house and its subterranean service tunnels, where smugglers, cultists, and desperate townsfolk have all been moving through the same black-market routes. The party must choose whether to negotiate with the smugglers, infiltrate the tunnels quietly, or force their way through guardians and traps. At the tunnel’s heart lies a ledger naming the next ritual site and the officials who have been quietly allowing the disappearances. The trail now points toward the council chapel and the buried choir-vault beneath Ashlight Cross.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Reveals the conspiracy’s logistics, identifies a protected ritual location, and gives the party leverage over local power brokers.

sideQuests.title: A Smuggler’s Bargain
sideQuests.description: A tunnel guide offers passage in exchange for protection from cult reprisals. The party can accept, expose, or double-cross the guide, changing how much of the underground network becomes available later.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Creates a meaningful alliance-or-enmity decision that alters access to hidden routes beneath the Expanse.

sideQuests.title: Sealed in Salt
sideQuests.description: A side chamber contains salt-sealed coffins and a warding script that may be reactivated to block the approaching darkness. Recovering the script requires navigating a trapped archive and possibly fighting the dead that still guard it.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Provides a defensive ward that can weaken later undead threats and offers proof that the town once knew how to contain the buried evil.

plotPoints.title: Council of Broken Saints
plotPoints.description: The trail leads to a ruined civic chapel where the town’s surviving elders, wardens, and secretive cult intermediaries gather under a fragile truce. Here the party must navigate a dangerous social confrontation: expose the conspiracy, broker an alliance, or fracture the council to force open the truth. The hidden manipulator behind the unrest reveals that the buried entity beneath the Expanse is not merely waking, but being deliberately fed memories, names, and sacrifices to reopen an ancient gate. The chapel’s surviving rites may also offer a way to protect Numillian’s wider ward network from the damage spreading south from the hidden city.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Turns the investigation into a public crisis, reshaping local loyalties and confirming that the final threat is an engineered awakening, not an accident.

sideQuests.title: The Witness Behind the Screen
sideQuests.description: A terrified witness knows who ordered the disappearances but will only speak if escorted safely through the chapel’s hostile factions. The party can protect the witness, interrogate them, or use them as bait to reveal an assassin.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Supplies the last clear testimony needed to identify the ritual’s architect.

sideQuests.title: Wardkeeper’s Rite
sideQuests.description: A surviving wardkeeper asks the party to help perform a partial cleansing rite in the chapel’s nave. Success can calm local spirits and weaken the force gathering below, while failure may unleash a hostile manifestation mid-rite.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Influences the difficulty of the climactic encounter by strengthening or breaking the town’s remaining protections.

plotPoints.title: The Buried Choir Beneath Ashlight Cross
plotPoints.description: The final clues point to a sinkhole beneath the oldest shrine district, where a buried choir-vault has cracked open into a chamber of chanting cultists, awakened dead, and a mind-warding presence bound in failing stone. The party descends into the hidden sanctum to confront the entity being awakened and the cult leaders feeding it. The climax should mix combat with a ritual race: disrupt the chant, rescue any surviving captives, and decide whether to destroy the vault, rebind the power, or claim its secrets at great risk. The ending of this confrontation can echo back through Numillian, confirming whether the hidden city’s secrecy endures or whether its wards begin to fail everywhere at once.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Culminates the Shuluth Expanse arc with the fate of Ashlight Cross and the buried warding power decided by the party’s choices.

sideQuests.title: The Last Bell of Ashlight
sideQuests.description: A cracked shrine bell can be rung to disrupt the vault’s chant, but reaching it requires crossing collapsing streets and hostile dead. If restored, it becomes a powerful tool during the final confrontation.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Provides a battlefield advantage in the climax by interrupting the ritual once per encounter or phase.

sideQuests.title: The Names Below
sideQuests.description: The vault contains a wall of carved names belonging to the missing townsfolk. Recovering or defacing the names changes whether the dead rise as enemies, spirits, or freed witnesses during the finale.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Determines the emotional tone of the ending and whether some victims can be saved or must be laid to rest.

dmNotes: The module is best run as a four-act escalation: border mystery, trial dungeon, civic conspiracy, and undercity crisis, ending in the Shuluth Expanse as the broadest and most dangerous reveal.
Kobe can be positioned as the key ward-stabilizer whose actions tie the First Trials Ruins to Numillian’s larger ward system.

Keep the same hidden manipulator concept threaded through all areas, but let each district reveal a different layer: border sabotage, trial control, forged access records, and memory-fed ward engines.
If you want a tighter campaign spine, treat the Curated Quarter as the political middle act and the Lower Vaults as the mechanical middle act before the Shuluth Expanse finale.
The final choice should meaningfully affect Numillian’s secrecy, the safety of its people, and whether the city remains an ally, a mystery, or a broken power center in future adventures.
